Because the mechanism is strategy-proof, truthful reporting is a dominant strategy: no possible misrepresentation of my preferences can yield a strictly better assignment regardless of how others rank schools. My true preference ordering is z > w > y > x, and I should therefore submit that ranking.

Although I have highest priority at w and y (w:1, y:1) and lower priority at z (z:2) and x (x:2), and many others favor y > x > w > z, these facts do not change the dominant strategy. Trying to rank a less-preferred school higher to game priorities cannot improve my outcome under a strategy-proof mechanism and may only risk getting a worse assignment. Thus I will report my true preferences.
